title: 1999 İzmit earthquake
summary: A magnitude 7.4 earthquake struck near İzmit in northwestern Turkey on August 17, 1999, on the northernmost strand of the North Anatolian fault system. More than 17,000 people died and about 500,000 were left homeless. Public anger fell on contractors and officials over poor construction and unenforced building codes; Greek aid helped ease relations.
